ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-contrast; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels and 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity black region extending laterally toward the trailing edges; high-intensity white fields dominate the outer lobes with sparse black mottling; dense black band along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; approximately 35-45 degree angle; base of indentation partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with varying pixel amplitudes; significant jagged peaks at the distal tips; smoother, lower-frequency variations closer to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer edges tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular cluster near the upper margin of the right lobe; several dark punctate marks within the left white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of vertical/oblique dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the right lobe; single diagonal mark on the left mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential minor tissue loss at the extreme right distal tip.
